subject: small chubby green dragon whelp with an orange belly, little bat wings and a long tail, standing on all fours
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: a purple energy arc following the tail

plan.source: Small chubby dragon on all fours, three-quarter facing right; head up; one wing half-open; tail curled high behind; forepaws empty.

frames.pose: Crouch back and left; head dips; shoulders twist left; wings tuck; tail coils high to left to load; front paws brace, rear-right and front-right planted, rear-left slides back.
frames.effect: Tiny purple sparkles gather at tail base.

frames.pose: Snap spin right; hips drive; tail fully extended sweeping low left-to-right; head down; wings tight; front paws dug in, rear-right pivot planted, rear-left heel up.
frames.effect: Thick purple energy arc trails the tail along the sweep, widest at mid-arc.

frames.pose: Over-rotate; chest leans right; head rebounds up; wings flare; tail passes through and starts curling on the right; front-right braced, rear-right planted, others sliding.
frames.effect: Thinner fading purple arc continuing past the tail tip with short wisps.

frames.pose: Settle to center; head level; wings partly fold; tail rises behind curling back toward rest; paws step back under body, all four planted evenly.
frames.effect: Few faint purple motes trailing from the tail tip.
